text: Saudi Arabia confirms three citizens were killed in Houthi missile strikes on Riyadh's King Khalid International Airport. The airport has reopened after a brief closure. The UN, UK and Arab states issued a joint condemnation of the attacks on Saudi airports.

judge.comment: Official Saudi confirmation of casualties, stated without adjudicating Houthi claims. Matches the 9 Oct digest and events.

factChecks.claim: Saudi Arabia confirms three citizens killed in Houthi missile strikes on Riyadh's King Khalid International Airport
UN, UK and Arab states issued a joint condemnation

text: Has the DRC Ebola outbreak peaked? On 15 Sept, Health Minister Kamba said daily deaths fell from ~50 to ~30. The same day, UN coordinator Julien Harneis called it "a deadly and a massive epidemic" still growing in other areas. Deaths passed 4,100 by 8 Oct.

judge.comment: Both sides attributed with dates; contested type never auto-approves. Quote is partially truncated in the tracker data, so a human should confirm wording.

factChecks.claim: DRC Health Minister said on 15 Sept daily deaths declined from roughly 50 to roughly 30
factChecks.source: ebola-outbreak unresolved disputes: DRC Ministry of Public Health

factChecks.claim: Julien Harneis, same day: 'it remains a deadly and a massive epidemic' with growth in other areas
factChecks.source: ebola-outbreak unresolved disputes: UN Special Ebola Coordinator / WHO

text: How many families has the Sinaloa cartel war displaced? Universidad Autónoma de Sinaloa: at least 9,000 (early 2025). The Sinaloa state government acknowledges 1,763 in official shelters. A five-fold gap, and the two counts may not measure the same thing.

judge.comment: Both sources are attributed, but the state figure has no as-of date in the tracker data. Human should confirm the date before publishing.

factChecks.claim: UAS documented at least 9,000 families displaced by early 2025
State government acknowledges only 1,763 families in official shelters
factChecks.source: sinaloa-fragmentation unresolved disputes; no as-of date recorded
